U.note: Compact, usable, well-measured wingless monitor-dragon with a nice goatherd source note, but fairly restrained and Komodo-anchored.

V.note: Textbook-complete field guide format but every beat (ember glow, hoard as radiator, wyvern leg count) is the stock fantasy dragon.

W.note: Rich taxonomy, synonyms and seasonal movement make it feel real, though long and a bit dry with gliding-drake premise.

X.note: Pleasant with a few good lines (a tired dragon, remembers who took the cup), but still the familiar ember-hoard dragon.

Y.note: A named scholar, a ferryman with a punting pole, and honest gaps give a wet river wyrm real personality and restraint.

Z.note: Wonderful archival detail (burned ewes, four-claw lesser dragon, disputed sheen) but long and dense.
